title: Choosing a turn in Rewind freezes kiln; the rewind note is never shown
observed: Esc Esc, Up, Enter: the Rewind dialog stays on screen and kiln stops responding. openRewind's onSelect called bridge.Send(MsgClearAndReplay{}) inside Update — the blocking Program.Send self-deadlocks the event loop (bridge.go documents this). Separately, msgDialogResult was only delivered to a still-open dialog's Apply, so the 'Rewound to before: …' outcome of a closed dialog was dropped.
expected: Enter rewinds, the transcript redraws from the session log, and a 'Rewound to before: <turn>' note follows the redrawn history.

fix.note: PTY test reproduced the freeze (dialog still drawn after Enter) and passes after; real-terminal re-drive pending.
